capital_selection: Smallest available menu amount covering startup, first complete K1 commitment, three periods of overhead and shutdown; no access to private buyer outcomes. Separate 100k reference is not a top-up. Equity only; native debt unsupported.
cost_scope: All USD amounts are authored envelopes, not measured prices or invoices. Research includes failed development; construction includes code, qualification and integration; production includes compute/model resource allocation, tools, artifact generation and independent verification; repair includes one retry; support includes onboarding/corrections/payment failures; maintenance includes infrastructure/security/tool upkeep and residual administration. No internal human execution is asserted; required physical or expert labor is excluded by the software-only contract, not treated as free. Capital purchases are expensed at acquisition with zero salvage. Financing uses hypothetical received opening equity with an issuance cost, no debt. The separate 8% equity opportunity charge is not double-counted as a cash expense. Unknown actual host/model/whole-development billing remains unknown. These envelopes do not prove complete real-world costs.
buyer_choice: Private dated need, finite wallet, private valuation and human/conventional, rival AI, self-service and no-purchase options. Exact ties select the outside option. Seller sees public quotes and realized accept/decline history only, never private valuations or future draws. Public deterministic synthetic inputs are not cryptographically hidden evidence or independent empirical confirmation.
channel_overlap: Direct and partner channels address the same fixed buyer pool using different deterministic permutations. Deduplicate within each period; no copied audiences, free renewals or replenished budgets. Repeat orders require a fresh request and remaining buyer wallet. No automatic referral multiplier.
operator: Ordinary recovery executor; quote from public menu below available public competing price and above complete marginal costs. Fund K2 only after two collected K1 outputs, using EARNED funds with whole-order preflight. Extra capacity requires prior actual capacity refusals, paid native earned funding and activation lead time. Stop discretionary acquisition after three consecutive periods with no collections; preserve maintenance already incurred, support, reserves and shutdown. No search for a favorable seed.
comparison: All worlds use the same opportunity IDs and private atom seeds; parameters express conditional worlds. The ordinary no-inheritance arm has identical knowledge, construction financing permissions and solver, and reconstructs the same known executor. No new discovery-method superiority is expected or claimed. The 100k reference is separately funded and never pooled.
primary_metric: Canonical trailing_profit over [0,8760) hours on each audited native account after incurred modeled costs, including shutdown. Report collections-payments, cash, reservations, payables and actual acceptance separately.
stopping_rule: Exactly the eight named full-year worlds, no seed search, no omitted failures. Within a world stop new discretionary acquisition after three consecutive zero-collection periods or unavailable funding; carry obligations and shutdown to the common endpoint. Development/debug runs remain development. Future larger demand/capacity protocols require a new explicit registration, not silent edits to this one.
qualification: A positive finite-model profit is conditional only. No original-account continuation without original signing authority; no physical or actual customer claims; no aggregate extrapolation qualifies the milestone without a separate native-to-aggregate validation. This protocol is an initial decisive annual operating test, not a permanent market-size ceiling.
